documents.title: Document Settings
documents.subtitle: How generated PDF documents are printed
documents.signatoryHint: Applies to every signature block: Letters, BAST, Official Memo, Purchase Order, Payment Receipt, Proposal, Certificate and Staff Raport. Names of HRIS users follow each person's own degree choice in My Profile; this setting covers other names (e.g. clients or outside parties).

withDegree.title: Name with degree
withDegree.description: Prints the signatory name exactly as typed on the document.

nameOnly.title: Name only
nameOnly.description: Drops titles before the name (Dr., Ir., Prof., ...) and degrees after the comma.

documents.saved: Document setting saved. It applies to PDFs generated from now on.

sdmFields.title: SDM Field
sdmFields.subtitle: List of fields/roles selectable when adding an SDM Resource in Operational Cost
sdmFields.deleteFailed: Failed to delete field. It may still be in use by SDM Resource.

payroll.title: Payroll Settings
payroll.subtitle: Control how Payroll is automatically generated
payroll.generationHint: Who is included when Payroll is generated.
payroll.exemptionBefore: By default, generating Payroll requires an employee to have at least one attendance record for that month, or they're left out entirely. Turning this on keeps
payroll.exemptionAfter: employees included even with zero attendance records -- full attendance is assumed for them, with no deduction. Everyone else still needs actual attendance records regardless of this setting.

form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Independence Day, Aldy's Birthday, Sprint Review
form.recurringHint: Use this for holidays and birthdays -- only the day and month matter, the year above is ignored. Leave unchecked for a one-time date, like a specific meeting.

certificate.title: Certificate Configuration
certificate.subtitle: Automatic numbering format and certificate background template settings
certificate.numberingHint: The automatic number printed on every certificate.
certificate.templateHint: Without a specific template, certificates use the default premium template provided by the system. Upload an image to use your own background. (size guide : 297 X 210 mm)
certificate.templateRequired: Template name and background file are required.
certificate.emptyMessage: Certificates will use the default template.

attendance.title: Attendance Settings
attendance.subtitle: Control whether staff can Clock In/Out on Saturday & Sunday
attendance.weekendBefore: By default, Clock In/Out is disabled every Saturday & Sunday since those aren't scheduled work days. Turning this on lets staff clock in on weekends -- it's automatically recorded as
attendance.weekendAfter: , not counted toward their regular attendance rate.
attendance.officeBefore: Employees whose Work Location is set to
attendance.officeAfter: must Clock In within this radius of the office coordinates below. Remote/Hybrid employees are never checked against this.
